name: Claw Finance
description: Bridge tool: call claw-finance-agent POST /ask (RAG, disclosure, crawl fallback).

clawApiUrl.description: claw-api 基址（无尾斜杠），如 http://api:9000；可被 CLAW_API_URL / CLAW_FINANCE_API_URL 覆盖

askTimeoutMs.description: /ask 请求超时毫秒，默认 180000，上限 600000；可被 CLAW_FINANCE_ASK_TIMEOUT_MS 覆盖

askMaxRetries.description: 可重试状态码时的最大重试次数，上限 3；可被 CLAW_FINANCE_ASK_RETRIES 覆盖
